rules: The four core modules and the Group Research Project are compulsory.
Every year 2 elective is worth 5 ECTS.
Take one i-Explore module (Group A) and four Group B electives.
There are no compulsory modules in year 3; every MATH6 module is worth 7.5 ECTS.
Take 60 or 62.5 ECTS in total: eight 7.5 ECTS modules, or seven 7.5 ECTS modules plus two 5 ECTS modules.
At least seven of your modules must be MATH6 (level 6) maths modules.
The rest can be another MATH6 module, a year 2 maths elective you have not taken, an approved module from another department, or up to two Computing modules.
At most one CLCC/Horizons or BPES module (5 ECTS); only one of the three BPES modules may be taken.
No more than two modules per term may have 50% or more of their assessment in term time.
You may not take both the MATH6 and MATH7 forms of the same module; level 7 modules need permission from the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
Register for between three and six modules in the autumn; registration closes at 1pm on the Monday of week 4.
